name: Battlefront
summary: The Battlefront is a contentious stretch of southern Silverpine Forest spanning the lowlands between Shadowfang Keep and the Greymane Wall. It marks the active clash between the Forsaken securing their southern border and Alliance-aligned forces pushing out from the walled kingdom of Gilneas.

sections.title: A Contested Valley
sections.body: Stretching south toward the towering Greymane Wall and beneath the crags of Shadowfang Keep, the Battlefront encompasses murky shallows, thick pine canopy, and fractured outposts. For travelers moving along the King's Road, the serene chill of Silverpine abruptly breaks into military cordons, fortified encampments, and roving scouting parties.

sections.title: Lines of Engagement
sections.body: The front is bisected by the clash of two entrenched armies. The Forsaken deploy from the Forsaken Front to solidify Horde dominion over Lordaeron's southern fringe, while the 7th Legion and the Gilneas Liberation Front stage out of nearby entrenched camps. The nearby settlement of Pyrewood Village remains caught in the crossfire of this brewing conflict, while indigenous marsh crocolisks thrive in the surrounding mire.

faq.answer: The Battlefront lies in southern Silverpine Forest, situated between the high bluffs of Shadowfang Keep and the southern barrier of the Greymane Wall.

faq.q: Who is fighting at the Battlefront?
faq.answer: The region is an active battleground between the Forsaken representing the Horde and an allied Alliance force composed of the 7th Legion and the Gilneas Liberation Front.

faq.q: What major camps border this area?
faq.answer: The Horde maintains the Forsaken Front as their primary base of operations, while the Alliance operates out of the 7th Legion Base Camp and the Gilneas Liberation Front Base Camp.

faq.q: Why is the terrain here so swampy?
faq.answer: The lowland contains shallow marshes and remnants of ancient waterways, believed by scholars to be the dried or shifted bed of the historic River Arevass that once flowed past Pyrewood toward the sea.

angles.text: Holding the line here prevents Alliance incursions from pushing north through Silverpine toward the Undercity and the heart of Lordaeron.
Controlling this threshold provides a crucial staging point to aid southern resistance forces and challenge Forsaken supremacy in the woods.
